verdict.rationale: The evidence never says that IRCC forms or their instruction guides can be downloaded from the site, or that this works without an account. The only related item (ircc-docs-8) is a navigation label listing "forms" next to accounts and biometrics, which does not show downloadability or account-free access. Public pages like the processing-time checker are a different capability and are not credited here.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
